decision_records.decision: @Doc node id = '@Doc/<repo-relative-posix-path>' (full sheet/doc path, extension kept), mirroring @File/<path> exactly. Zero collision risk, deterministic, invertible. Node type='doc'; NO file/line on the node (endpoint precedent — GI-6/map/canonical-graph consumers already skip file-less nodes); metadata carries sheetPath, docType ('resource-sheet'|'foundation'), docStatus, placeholderSections, subject, task, relatedFiles.

'documents' EdgeRelationship: @Doc node -> @File/<documented-file> file-grain node (direction: doc documents file; walk docsFor(file) via inbound index). Resolved ONLY when the documented file is in the scan universe (state.sources); otherwise emitted UNRESOLVED with reason 'documents_target_not_in_scan' — endpoint precedent: never dropped, never a dangling resolved edge (GI-3 safe). Evidence variant { kind: 'documents', sheetPath, docStatus, placeholderSections, documentsPath }. Documented in-universe files are added to the file-grain seenFiles set (same guarantee pattern as routes/frontendCalls) via the SAME fileGrainNodeId helper.

Doc facts are REPO-GLOBAL, not per-file bundle facts: collected fresh each scan (sync fs, deterministic sorted glob over coderef/resource-sheets/*.md + coderef/foundation-docs/*.md relative to projectPath — repo-agnostic per-repo convention, no fleet layout). They deliberately do NOT enter the incremental byFile fact store (sidesteps the FU-4 absolute-key writeback defect entirely); collection runs in BOTH orchestrator call sites (run() + assembleAndResolve()) before constructGraph, passed through state.docs — constructGraph stays pure, incremental parity by construction.

Foundation docs (no frontmatter, G1): ingested as @Doc nodes with docType='foundation', slug from filename, docStatus='generated', NO documents edges — resource sheets are the edge-bearing class. Frontmatter-less sheets (SCRIPTS): skipped with counted skip-reason. Missing status: defaults 'draft'. parent_project ignored.

Retrieval ranking contract (pack_context governing-docs block): projected-facts > approved prose > draft; placeholder sections NEVER authority (placeholderSections>0 flagged; block orders approved before draft, annotates provenance). Surfacing lives in the ENGINES (packContext, condenseSummary, projectMapData) so CLI+MCP wrappers inherit with zero wrapper edits — required by the GX-003 concurrency constraint (context-tools.ts/server.ts untouchable this WO). OUT of scope: standards overlay (GX-005 P2), doc-content indexing (RAG owns content).
